examples.en: He struck the serpent, and he freed the waters. He split the rock with the heavy stone. He led the cows out of the hollow of the rock. The sun grew bright again over the earth. Him we praise now; him we call upon. Let us sing to him, the strong one!

examples.pie: wóyḱe toy dʰéyǵʰesh₂ stestóh₂e. stestóh₂e. stégos gʷr̥h₂ú. h₁óynos h₂nḗr h₁íd ne tl̥néh₂ti. h₁íd tl̥néh₂esi? h₁eǵóh₂ moy suHnéwes-kʷe h₁íd tl̥néh₂omes. kʷóm gʷémete? h₂ewsér gʷémomes. gʷm̥té usméy-kʷe mḗms pékʷōh₂.
examples.en: Neighbour, your walls are standing! They stand. The roof is heavy. One man does not lift it. Will you lift it? My sons and I will lift it. When will you come? We will come at dawn. Come, and I will cook meat for you all.

examples.pie: kúdʰe wíHre séh₂lm̥ léǵesi? sélesi. sóh₂wl̥ sélos h₂sowséyeti albʰóm-kʷe séh₂lm̥ léǵomes. sélos dweh₂róm? h₁íd ne dweh₂róm méǵʰye ḱóm gʷémesi? gʷémoh₂ séh₂lm̥-kʷe moy ḱóymom wéǵʰōh₂. bʰólǵʰim h₁áyso sḗh₂l gʷr̥h₂ús.
examples.en: Man, where do you gather salt? In the salt marsh. The sun dries the marsh, and we gather the white salt. Is the salt marsh far? It is not far; will you come with me? I will come, and I will carry salt to my village. Take a bag; salt is heavy.

examples.pie: h₁élḱos pléh₁dʰet h₂linéHt-kʷe tód gʷtúh₁.

examples.en: Now, gods, hear our word! Now we call you with a hymn. Come to the sacrifice, sit down by the fire. Become glad; be kindly to us.

examples.pie: kʷíd deywóybʰos mléwHsi? mléwHmi déywōs moy gʷṓs h₂ówins-kʷe ph₂sté. nu h₁éymos h₁erkʷóm dédeh₃mi. ḱlush₁yónti te? ḱlush₁yónti me gʷówes-kʷe moy pléh₁dʰontor.
examples.en: What do you say to the gods? I say: Gods, guard my cows and sheep! Then I give them a hymn. Do they hear you? They hear me, and my cattle increase.

examples.en: Sing a hymn to the Dawn! Dawn, daughter of Sky, grow bright for us! The birds sing to you, and the cattle go to the pasture. Your hymn is dear to me. Then let us sing it together!

examples.en: Father, why do you not eat? My teeth are gone, daughter. The meat is hard for me. Then I will prepare soft mush with butter for you. You are a good daughter. Did your brothers eat? They ate, and they went to the field.

examples.pie: tétḱō pérkʷum widét h₁ím-kʷe témh₁t. kʷékʷlom h₁ésmōd péyḱt. h₁ím h₁óloh₁ térdt. h₁ést kʷékʷlos méǵh₂s. pótn̥yeh₂ey h₁ím h₁opéyet. pótnih₂ gʷṓs yéwgt h₁íns-kʷe h₂éǵrom h₂éǵet. kʷékʷlos dʰr̥ǵʰtós h₁ésti.

examples.pie: kʷósmōd dréws tétḱon rótons démesi? h₁íns pr̥kʷéws dréws démoh₂. h₁íd dʰr̥ǵʰtóm. kʷóti dinóns wr̥ǵyési? kʷetwórn̥s dinóns. nu néwōy wóǵʰōy uksénn̥s yunégmi. méǵʰye wr̥ǵyḗsi? tébʰye wr̥ǵyṓh₂ h₁éwkoh₂-kʷe.
examples.en: Carpenter, from which wood do you build wheels? I build them from the wood of the oak. It is hard. How many days do you work? Four days. Then I join the oxen to the new wagon. Will you work for me? I will work for you, and I will learn.

examples.pie: moysóm moy péruti pérh₂s. nu h₁éy néḱus. kéh₂ilos h₁ést h₁yód h₁ím pérh₂m̥. h₂elgʷʰóm moy h₂éti gʰéldʰe. h₁ím h₂éti ne gʰéldʰōh₂. h₂egʷnóm toy déh₃oh₂.
examples.en: You sold me a ram last year. Now he is dead. He was healthy when I sold him. Pay me back the price! I will not pay it back. I will give you a lamb.

examples.pie: h₁yós diwéh₁ h₃m̥néh₃eti dʰrugʰyḗti-kʷe só dwís gʰéldʰetu. tósmey kʷis mē bʰebʰidʰyéh₁t. h₁yód h₂nḗr h₂elgʷʰóm h₁wogʷʰéyet h₁ím-kʷe ne h₁opéyet h₁ésyo h₃nóbʰis h₁ím déh₃tu. sóh₂wl̥ h₁óytons widéh₁yeti.
examples.en: Whoever swears by Sky and lies, let him pay twice. May no one trust that man. If a man promised a price and did not give it, let his kin give it. The Sun sees the oaths.

examples.en: Neighbour, give me grain. My daughters are dying of hunger. I have little grain. My grandsons are hungry. I shall repay you in the summer. Then take a share. Do not tell the others. May the gods give you good things, friend.
